subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic feature of epithelial tissue?

options.text: Covers most organs and cavities within the body
Seperated from the underlying tissue by a cellular, non fibrous basement membrane

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Epithelial tissues have no intercellular spaces, making them tightly packed and forming continuous sheets.
 
• They cover most organs and cavities within the body, providing a protective barrier.
 
• Epithelial tissues are separated from the underlying tissue by a basement membrane, which is non-cellular and fibrous.
 
• The basement membrane is composed of proteins like collagen and glycoproteins, providing support and anchoring the epithelium.
 
• Epithelial tissues play roles in protection, secretion, absorption, and sensation in various organs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Connective Tissue**

 
 
• Connective tissues support, bind, and protect other tissues and organs.
 
• They have various types, including loose connective tissue, dense connective tissue, cartilage, bone, and blood.
 
 
 
• **Muscle Tissue**
 
 
• Muscle tissues are responsible for movement in the body.
 
• They are categorized into three types: skeletal, cardiac, and smooth muscle tissues.
 
 
 
• **Nervous Tissue**
 
 
• Nervous tissues are specialized for the conduction of electrical impulses.
 
• They consist of neurons and glial cells, with functions in sensing stimuli and transmitting signals.
